chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Let the insolvent go free, just as Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has let him go free."

key_terms.الْمُعْسِرِ: The insolvent person; one in financial hardship
key_terms.تَبَارَكَ: Blessed is He; abundant in goodness
key_terms.خَلَّاهُ: He left him; He released him
key_terms.سَبِيلَ: Way; course; here, the path to freedom from constraint

ai.seo_question: What does the Imam عليه السلام teach about dealing with an insolvent debtor?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام instructs people to grant relief to the insolvent debtor and not press him with hardship. The teaching highlights mercy, social responsibility, and acting toward others in a manner reflecting Allah's grace and forbearance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Let the insolvent go free, just as Allah (swt), the Blessed and Exalted, has set him free."
